description: A new unconditional root-import dependency is absent from the ordinary runtime dependency declaration.
trigger: An existing caller executes import exllamav3 in an otherwise working environment containing the declared runtime dependencies but no Transformers installation.
expected_behavior: Import-only callers should not need an undeclared package for an integration they never invoke.
actual_behavior: The root initializer imports integration, its initializer imports integration.transformers, and that module immediately imports Transformers symbols. If reached without Transformers installed, this raises ModuleNotFoundError before the caller can use the package. Calling patch_transformers is not required to reach the failure. The parent initializer did not have this path.

verification.description: Compared both initializer chains, the adapter imports and every discovered requirements file plus setup.py.
verification.limits: No import was executed. Existing native-extension or other dependency failures may occur earlier; transitive installations may happen to provide Transformers, but the project's runtime declaration does not guarantee it.

introductions.rationale: 255 adds the adapter/import path described by the finding; the parent has no integration package.
